title: Skali installer node configuration
description: Per-host install configuration consumed by skali-installer install --config.

capabilities.description: Designated workload capabilities for this node.

cluster.description: Cluster name created by the first server. Defaults to production.

join.description: Join an existing cluster instead of creating one.

server.description: URL of an existing K3s server, for example https://cp-1.internal:6443.

tokenFile.description: Path to a file holding the join token.

nodeIP.description: Optional IP address this node advertises inside the cluster; set it on multi-homed hosts.
